name: InterContinental Sydney
insider_take: This harbourfront icon sits on the historic site of Fort Macquarie, where convicts once built Sydney's first fortification in 1821.
whats_special: The InterContinental Sydney boasts one of the world's most coveted addresses at Circular Quay, offering unobstructed views of both the Opera House and Harbour Bridge. The hotel's Club InterContinental floors occupy the prime real estate with floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing the harbor's daily ballet of ferries, yachts, and cruise ships.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view room on floors 25-31 for the ultimate Opera House vista, especially magical during the annual Vivid Sydney light festival when the shells come alive with projections.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to the Royal Botanic Gardens' secret Mrs. Macquaries Chair lookout—just a 5-minute walk—offers the classic postcard shot of the Opera House and Harbour Bridge together. Plus, you're steps from the hidden Customs House library with its stunning glass floor model of Sydney.
pros: Prime location at Circular Quay with Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House views
Exceptional dining options including award-winning restaurants
Luxurious accommodations with harbour-view rooms and suites
cons: Busy tourist area with high foot traffic
